dedupe_keys.name: high spatiotemporal resolution mapping of global urban change from 1985 to 2015

description: The Global Annual Urban Dynamics team publishes thirty-metre maps of urbanisation and green recovery worldwide from 1985 to 2015. The data are organised into 224 ten-degree tiles, with pixel values identifying the year of change and zero denoting no data. Figshare also provides interpreted urban-extent samples for 1985 and 2015, validation years in an Excel table, and the tiling grid as Shapefiles. Archives are publicly accessible and free under CC-BY-4.0. A 2021 update corrects mosaic striping in one tile. A limitation is that a mapped year is a remotely inferred transition and does not describe the type or capacity of infrastructure constructed. The grids can supply historical urban-cover changes for drainage, exposure and land-use simulations. They complement GISA with an explicit green-recovery product and validation material. The linked Earth Engine demonstration was not executed and no data were obtained.
